props.text: Record scrap directly against a held LOT (no split, no hold release). The LOT stays on hold.

config.script:
d = self.view.custom.scrapDraft
	lotName = (d.get("lotName") or "").strip()
	qty = BlueRidge.Common.Util.toIntOrNone(d.get("quantity"))
	defectId = d.get("defectCodeId")
	remarks = (d.get("remarks") or "").strip() or None
	if not lotName:
		BlueRidge.Common.Ui.notifyResult({"Status": False, "Message": "Enter a LOT name."}, "Scrap Held LOT")
		return
	if defectId is None:
		BlueRidge.Common.Ui.notifyResult({"Status": False, "Message": "Select a defect code."}, "Scrap Held LOT")
		return
	if qty is None or qty <= 0:
		BlueRidge.Common.Ui.notifyResult({"Status": False, "Message": "Enter a reject quantity greater than zero."}, "Scrap Held LOT")
		return
	lot = BlueRidge.Lots.Lot.getByName(lotName)
	if not lot or lot.get("Id") is None:
		BlueRidge.Common.Ui.notifyResult({"Status": False, "Message": "No LOT found named '" + lotName + "'."}, "Scrap Held LOT")
		return
	lotId = lot.get("Id")
	held = BlueRidge.Quality.Hold.getOpenByLotOne(lotId)
	if not (held and held.get("IsHeld")):
		BlueRidge.Common.Ui.notifyResult({"Status": False, "Message": "LOT '" + lotName + "' is not on hold. Use the normal scrap flow for un-held LOTs."}, "Scrap Held LOT")
		return
	result = BlueRidge.Workorder.RejectEvent.record({"lotId": lotId, "defectCodeId": defectId, "quantity": qty, "remarks": remarks}, allowHeldLot=True)
	BlueRidge.Common.Ui.notifyResult(result, "Scrap recorded")
	if result and result.get("Status"):
		self.view.custom.scrapDraft = {"lotName": "", "defectCodeId": None, "quantity": "", "remarks": ""}
		self.view.custom.refreshToken = (self.view.custom.refreshToken or 0) + 1

props.text: Bulk Hold — search LOTs and place a hold on several at once

transforms.code:
sel = [int(x) for x in (self.view.custom.bulkSelectedLotIds or [])]
	rows = []
	for r in (value or []):
		lid = r.get("Id")
		rows.append({"lotId": lid, "lotName": r.get("LotName") or "?", "partNumber": r.get("ItemPartNumber") or "", "statusCode": r.get("LotStatusCode") or "", "locationName": r.get("CurrentLocationName") or "", "selected": (int(lid) in sel if lid is not None else False)})
	return rows

config.script:
ids = self.view.custom.bulkSelectedLotIds or []
	if self.view.custom.bulkHoldTypeId is None:
		BlueRidge.Common.Ui.notifyResult({"Status": False, "Message": "Select a hold type."}, "Bulk Hold")
		return
	if len(ids) == 0:
		BlueRidge.Common.Ui.notifyResult({"Status": False, "Message": "Select at least one LOT."}, "Bulk Hold")
		return
	reason = (self.view.custom.bulkReason or "").strip() or None
	res = BlueRidge.Quality.Hold.placeBulk(ids, self.view.custom.bulkHoldTypeId, reason)
	BlueRidge.Common.Ui.notifyResult(res, "Bulk Hold")
	if res and res.get("Status"):
		self.view.custom.refreshToken = (self.view.custom.refreshToken or 0) + 1
		self.view.custom.bulkResults = []
		self.view.custom.bulkSelectedLotIds = []

d = self.view.custom.releaseDraft
	heId = BlueRidge.Common.Util.toIntOrNone(d.get("holdEventId"))
	remarks = (d.get("releaseRemarks") or "").strip() or None
	if heId is None:
		BlueRidge.Common.Ui.notifyResult({"Status": False, "Message": "Enter a Hold Event Id."}, "Release Hold")
		return
	result = BlueRidge.Quality.Hold.release(heId, releaseRemarks=remarks)
	BlueRidge.Common.Ui.notifyResult(result, "Hold released")
	if result and result.get("Status"):
		self.view.custom.releaseDraft = {"holdEventId": "", "releaseRemarks": ""}
		self.view.custom.refreshToken = (self.view.custom.refreshToken or 0) + 1
